# Shivek Khurana

> I make things. Mostly software, but sometimes clothes, courses, videos, or essays.

This file indexes the main public content on shivekkhurana.com for language models and other automated readers.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://shivekkhurana.com): Personal homepage, current work, health snapshots, and recent writing.
- [About](https://shivekkhurana.com/about): Background, photographs, and personal context.
- [Hire](https://shivekkhurana.com/hire): Consulting services around AI agents, full-stack product engineering, automation, and evals.
- [Projects](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects): Chronological project and work history.
- [Blog](https://shivekkhurana.com/blog): Essays and technical writing.
- [Videos](https://shivekkhurana.com/videos): Talks and recorded conversations.
- [Workouts](https://shivekkhurana.com/workouts): Public workout dashboard generated from state-of-being data.
- [Sleep](https://shivekkhurana.com/sleep): Sleep dashboard generated from state-of-being data.
- [RSS Feed](https://shivekkhurana.com/rss.xml): Recent blog posts in RSS format.
- [Sitemap](https://shivekkhurana.com/sitemap-index.xml): Machine-readable sitemap generated by Astro.

## Projects

- [Head of AI Systems (IC / Lead Architect) at Collab+Currency](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#head-of-ai-systems): 2025-07-01 to 2026-07-01. Designed AI infra for internal research: RAG tools, pricing analysis, Telegram-integrated agents. Architected privacy-focused infra (Cloudflare Workers, Pulumi, AWS, Docker, VPS). Built accounting automations in the BitTensor ecosystem.
- [Mobile Team Lead (Staff IC) at IFT](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#mobile-team-lead-ift): 2024-11-01 to 2025-07-31. Worked on Status React Native app (Clojure/Go 1m+ downloads). Implemented new design system. Shipped usage tracking + A/B testing framework (Mixpanel). Led wallet monetization architecture: staking & swap flows. Built AI automations for git/project workflows.
- [Co-Founder at Meta Blocks](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#co-founder-meta-blocks): 2021-09-01 to 2025-01-31. Architected Solana NFT upgrade protocol ($10M market cap). Built SDKs and Backend API (ClojureScript). Grew community to 8k+; drove developer adoption with docs & demos. Led post-hack infra recovery; rebuilt protocol resilience, coordinated audits. Balanced technical leadership with company ops (legal, HR, finance).
- [Seed (priced) Investor and Advisor at Skillstrainer](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#investor-advisor-skillstrainer): 2021-01-01 to present. Skillstrainer is the world's largest vocational skilling platform with over 4m users in India and Africa.
- [Senior Engineer at Status](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#senior-engineer-status): 2020-11-01 to 2022-02-28. Extended Ethereum wallet + chat app (1.2M+ downloads). Architected anonymous telemetry pipeline (Waku + Airflow). Optimized Ethereum UX with Status-Go.
- [Volunteer at Karuna 2020](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#co-founder-karuna-2020): 2020-03-01 to 2020-04-04. Built a platform to bring people together to help feed India during COVID-19. Created website, open-data API, and tools for coordinating food distribution efforts across the country.
- [Open Source Contributor at Ubiq](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#ubiq): 2019-04-26 to 2019-05-08. Built an experimental GraphQL API builder with minimal code. Uses interceptors defined statically in resolvers.edn file. Built with Lacinia, Lacinia-Pedestal, and Integrant framework.
- [Creator at Eiphop](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#eiphop): 2018-09-21 to 2022-01-11. Built a fetch-like wrapper for Electron's IPC. Abstracts Electron's multi-channel IPC model into an HTTP-like interface, simplifying communication between main and renderer processes. Open source library with 28+ stars.
- [Founder at HTTPSLocalhost](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#httpslocalhost): 2018-09-18 to 2019-02-15. Built a Mac App for managing local SSL domains. Electron-based desktop application that simplifies running TLS/SSL services locally for developers.
- [Senior Full-Stack Engineer at JUXT](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#senior-full-stack-engineer-juxt): 2017-11-01 to 2020-04-30. Built Vodafone UK Loyalty Platform (10M+ users, Clojure/React + Kafka). Designed identity protection services & B2B secure file-sharing platform. Promoted to Tech Lead; delivered GraphQL/REST APIs, multi-lingual UIs.
- [Founder at Speer](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#speer): 2017-08-05 to 2018-09-09. Speer helps sales teams observe customer body language and change their message accordingly, making sales relevant rather than loud. It enables mindful outbound campaigns, finds the most interested live-chat leads, and provides analytics to identify quality leads.
- [Aspiring founder at Appuity](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#appuity): 2017-07-15 to 2017-12-05. Built sentiment analysis service for Google Play Store reviews. Includes backend API providing programmatic access to analyze user sentiments in app reviews, and React-based frontend demo showcasing capabilities and demonstrating Fractal design pattern.
- [UI Team Lead at Komplitax](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#ui-team-lead-komplitax): 2017-01-01 to 2017-12-31. Built tax dashboards with dynamic JSON-schema forms.
- [Full-Stack Developer at PFRepo](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#full-stack-developer-pfrepo): 2016-01-01 to 2016-12-31. Developed resume management and automated PDF pipelines.
- [Tech Lead at Gingr Messenger](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#tech-lead-gingr-messenger): 2015-01-01 to 2015-12-31. Led development of a hyperlocal chat and delivery platform.
- [Aspiring founder at Quote Hero](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#quote-hero): 2014-03-22 to 2016-05-17. Built Android application for quotes collection and management.
- [Full-Stack Developer at Musejam](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#full-stack-developer-musejam): 2014-01-01 to 2014-12-31. Built Laravel-based artist and event management system.
- [Aspiring founder at Rewave](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#rewave): 2013-12-01 to 2015-07-31. Built an Android app that converts your phone into a presentation remote. Connects to your computer over Bluetooth to control slides with simple tap gestures - single tap to go forward, double tap to go back.
- [Consultant at Bootstrapp](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#consultant-bootstrapp): 2013-06-01 to 2013-12-31. Implemented IAM, CI/CD, and data-ops for refurbished electronics marketplace.
- [Aspiring founder at Bowdin](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#bowdin): 2013-03-15 to 2013-09-18. Built a Hot or Not clone inspired by Mark Zuckerberg's early project. Operates using Facebook and Tumblr data for content.
- [Aspiring founder at Joe Humps](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#joe-humps): 2012-12-04 to 2013-09-05. Built a like/dislike widget that can be embedded on any website.
- [Aspiring founder at Zeroarity](https://shivekkhurana.com/projects#zeroarity): 2012-08-20 to 2013-09-06. Built an online workout app enabling users to exercise at home with minimal or no equipment. Includes a control panel to add and remove exercises/routines.
